description: Carta Incendi 2007 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cartanet.regione.abruzzo.it. Map of the areas covered by fires in 2007, made in support of the Civil Protection, by means of video digitisation of the perimeter related to each fire, with the intersection of the perimeters thus obtained with the soil use map in order to determine for each of them the types of land involved. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Fire Card 2007" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include incendi, aree percorse da incendi. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
